entities.name: Nimbys of Tharkair
entities.description: Planeswalker who fought for 'the Cause', summoning Isle of Indigo villagers to battle.

entities.name: Ruannon
entities.description: Villager of the Isle of Indigo summoned by Nimbys and killed in battle.

entities.name: Alandrah
entities.description: Ruannon's wife, summoned by Nimbys and killed as an archer.

entities.name: Peter Langwynd
entities.description: Son of Ruannon and Alandrah who stabbed Nimbys and refused his offer.

entities.name: Isle of Indigo
entities.description: Island home of Ruannon, Alandrah and Peter.

entities.name: Indigents
entities.description: People of the Isle of Indigo.

entities.name: Foulmere
entities.description: Place where Peter was summoned and lived afterward.

entities.name: Enchanted dagger
entities.description: Dagger Nimbys sent Ruannon back with as weregild, later used by Peter.

events.summary: Nimbys helps the village then leaves, after which people vanish; he summons Ruannon to a distant battlefield where he is killed.
events.quote: Ruannon was one of the first, summoned to a distant battlefield by Nimbys, where he was killed.

events.summary: Nimbys summons Alandrah with Peter clinging to her; she is turned into an archer and killed in battle.
events.quote: She was turned into an archer and killed in the battle fighting on behalf of Nimbys

events.summary: Peter stabs Nimbys in the heart with the enchanted dagger, but it does not wound him.
events.quote: stabbed him in the heart with the enchanted dagger, but it did not kill Nimbys

events.summary: Peter refuses Nimbys's recruitment and offer of return home, and lives in Foulmere.
events.quote: Nimbys let Peter go to live in Foulmere where he had been summoned.

relations.note: Peter is the son of Ruannon and Alandrah.
relations.quote: Ruannon and Alandrah and their son Peter Langwynd

relations.note: Husband and wife, parents of Peter.
relations.quote: Ruannon and Alandrah and their son Peter Langwynd

relations.note: Peter stabbed Nimbys after his parents died fighting for him.
relations.quote: Enraged, Peter found Nimbys on the battlefield
